name: oneworld
body: Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors, every page read has a meta description, and an llms.txt is published. But the viewport sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no, so people can't pinch to zoom.
lesson: Drop maximum-scale and user-scalable from the viewport so people can zoom to 200%.
summary: www.oneworld.com scores 80 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 19 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: other sites can frame the page.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages read.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 4 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /flight-search. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: 42 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 7 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap_index.xml: www.globalsiteseo.com (7). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.oneworld.com.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 301 ms
Every page has a meta description
